Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

I've been writing to two pen pals, one is Korean and the other is Namibian. The Korean one comes from an area without a lot of resources and often tells me about how poor his family is, while the Namibian one writes to me about his exciting travels, so I know his financial situation is much better. Who is very poor?
A. The Korean one
B. The Namibian one
C. Cannot be determined
